convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom to call the SilverTrend signal indicator (a custom indicator), which is not a built-in MT5 indicator. The core entry signal depends on a custom indicator's buffer values, requiring the custom indicator logic to be replicated or the indicator source to be available for porting.

other_exits: Signal reversal closes existing position before opening new one in opposite direction

position_sizing.conditional_logic: Lots input parameter determines fixed lot size; negative values may be interpreted as risk-based fraction

custom_logic_notes: SilverTrend Duplex trades both long and short based on SilverTrend custom indicator signals. The indicator typically uses a channel breakout method with ATR-based thresholds to generate buy/sell dots. The 'Duplex' variant allows trading in both directions rather than long-only. Signal on previous bar ([1]) is used to trigger trades on current bar open. Digit adjustment (multiplying SL/TP by 10 for 5-digit brokers) is standard in this EA family. The custom indicator SilverTrend.mq5 must be available and its logic must be replicated for Python conversion.
python_conversion_notes: The SilverTrend custom indicator logic must be reimplemented in Python. The indicator uses a channel-based algorithm (typically comparing close prices against an ATR-derived channel over N bars to identify trend changes). Obtain the SilverTrend.mq5 source code to port the exact algorithm. Digit adjustment logic (multiply SL/TP by 10 for 5-digit brokers) must be handled in the Python equivalent. The EA uses previous bar signal values ([1]) for entry, which maps naturally to bar-based backtesting. Position gate is no_position - only one trade at a time.
